title: Getting started with rCoros
text: Store credentials ~/.Renviron never hard-coded script: restart R authenticate: Pass region = "eu" account created Europe. auth object just lightweight list — create per session pass every subsequent call.
code: COROS_EMAIL=you@example.com COROS_PASSWORD=secret library(rCoros)  auth <- coros_login() auth #> <coros_auth> #>   region:    us #>   user_id:   123456789 #>   logged in: 2026-06-07 08:00:00

title: Getting started with rCoros
text: coros_activities() returns one row per activity. default fetches last 30 days auto-paginates matching activities returned: Filter runs , look distance training load time:
code: library(dplyr)  acts <- coros_activities(auth) acts #> # A tibble: 47 × 16 #>   activity_id name            sport_type sport_name date       start_time #>   <chr>       <chr>                <int> <chr>      <date>     <dttm> #> 1 4780…       Morning Trail R…       102 Trail Run… 2026-06-06 2026-06-06 06:12:00 #> 2 4779…       Easy Run               100 Running    2026-06-04 2026-06-04 07:00:00 #> … runs <- acts |>   filter(sport_type %in% c(100L, 102L)) |>   arrange(date)  library(ggplot2)  ggplot(runs, aes(date, distance_km)) +   geom_col(fill = "#3A7BD5") +   labs(title = "Weekly volume", x = NULL, y = "Distance (km)")

title: Getting started with rCoros
text: Drill single activity get lap splits heart-rate zones:
code: detail <- coros_activity_detail(   auth,   activity_id = acts$activity_id[[1]],   sport_type  = acts$sport_type[[1]] )  # One-row summary detail$summary |> glimpse()  # Lap splits detail$laps  # Time in HR zones ggplot(detail$hr_zones, aes(factor(zone), minutes, fill = factor(zone))) +   geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +   scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdYlGn", direction = -1) +   labs(title = "Time in HR zones", x = "Zone", y = "Minutes")

title: Getting started with rCoros
text: coros_daily_metrics() pulls per-day HRV, resting heart rate, VO2max, training load, 90 days time: quick view just last 7 days, coros_hrv() hits lighter dashboard endpoint:
code: metrics <- coros_daily_metrics(auth, start_day = "20260101", end_day = "20260607")  # HRV trend with baseline ggplot(metrics, aes(date)) +   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hrv_baseline - 5, ymax = hrv_baseline + 5),               fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2) +   geom_line(aes(y = hrv_baseline), colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +   geom_point(aes(y = hrv), size = 1.5) +   labs(title = "Overnight HRV vs. baseline", x = NULL, y = "HRV (ms)") coros_hrv(auth) #> # A tibble: 7 × 4 #>   date         hrv baseline hrv_sd #>   <date>     <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl> #> 1 2026-06-01  61.2     58.4    4.1 #> 2 2026-06-02  64.8     58.8    3.9 #> …

title: Getting started with rCoros
text: Training load acute:chronic ratio coros_daily_metrics(). ratio ~1.5 useful proxy injury risk:
code: metrics |>   filter(!is.na(load_ratio)) |>   ggplot(aes(date, load_ratio)) +   geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.8, 1.3), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +   geom_line(colour = "#E06C2C", linewidth = 1) +   annotate("text", x = min(metrics$date), y = 1.35,            label = "Caution zone", hjust = 0, size = 3, colour = "grey40") +   labs(title = "Acute:chronic training load ratio",        x = NULL, y = "Load ratio")

title: Getting started with rCoros
text: coros_workouts() returns saved workout library two linked tibbles — workout header individual steps:
code: w <- coros_workouts(auth)  # All workouts w$workouts  # Steps for a specific workout w$steps |> filter(workout_id == w$workouts$id[[1]])

title: Getting started with rCoros
text: coros_schedule() shows ’s planned next two weeks (window specify):
code: sched <- coros_schedule(auth)  sched #> # A tibble: 9 × 5 #>   happen_day name              sport_name estimated_min completed #>   <date>     <chr>             <chr>               <dbl> <lgl> #> 1 2026-06-07 Long Run          Running              90   FALSE #> 2 2026-06-09 Recovery Run      Running              40   FALSE #> …

title: Getting started with rCoros
text: common pattern join activities back daily metrics explore recovery scores relate performance:
code: combined <- runs |>   left_join(     metrics |> select(date, hrv, hrv_baseline, rhr, load_ratio),     by = "date"   )  ggplot(combined, aes(hrv, avg_hr, colour = load_ratio)) +   geom_point(size = 2.5) +   geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "grey40") +   scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "Load ratio") +   labs(     title  = "HRV vs. average run HR",     x      = "Overnight HRV (ms)",     y      = "Average HR (bpm)"   )

text: rCoros provides tidy interface COROS Training Hub API. Authenticate , pull activities, daily wellness metrics, HRV, workout programmes, training calendars — tibbles ready dplyr ggplot2.

title: Access COROS Training Hub Fitness Data in R
text: Install development version GitHub:
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("mattyoreilly/rCoros")

title: Access COROS Training Hub Fitness Data in R
text: Add credentials ~/.Renviron never scripts. easiest way open file : Add two lines, save, restart R:
code: usethis::edit_r_environ() COROS_EMAIL=you@example.com COROS_PASSWORD=secret

title: Access COROS Training Hub Fitness Data in R
code: library(rCoros) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2)  # Authenticate (reads COROS_EMAIL / COROS_PASSWORD from env) auth <- coros_login()  # Activities from the last 30 days — all pages fetched automatically acts <- coros_activities(auth)  # Running and trail running only runs <- acts |> filter(sport_type %in% c(100L, 102L))  # Lap splits and HR zones for the most recent run detail <- coros_activity_detail(   auth,   activity_id = runs$activity_id[[1]],   sport_type  = runs$sport_type[[1]] ) detail$laps detail$hr_zones  # 28-day wellness metrics: HRV, RHR, VO2max, training load metrics <- coros_daily_metrics(auth)  # HRV vs. baseline ggplot(metrics, aes(date)) +   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hrv_baseline - 5, ymax = hrv_baseline + 5),               fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2) +   geom_line(aes(y = hrv_baseline), colour = "steelblue") +   geom_point(aes(y = hrv)) +   labs(x = NULL, y = "HRV (ms)")  # Upcoming training schedule coros_schedule(auth)

title: List activities — coros_activities
text: Returns tidy tibble activities recorded within date range, one row per activity.

title: List activities — coros_activities
code: coros_activities(   auth,   start_day = format(Sys.Date() - 30, "%Y%m%d"),   end_day = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),   page = 1L,   size = 30L,   n_max = Inf )

title: List activities — coros_activities
text: auth coros_auth object coros_login(). start_day Start date range "YYYYMMDD" format.  Defaults 30 days ago. end_day End date range "YYYYMMDD" format.  Defaults today. page Page number paginated results (default 1L). size Number results per page (default 30L). n_max Maximum total activities return.  Set Inf fetch pages automatically (default Inf).

title: List activities — coros_activities
text: tibble::tibble() columns: activity_id Unique activity identifier (character). name Activity name remark. sport_type Numeric sport type code. sport_name Human-readable sport name. date Date activity (Date). start_time Start timestamp (POSIXct, UTC). duration_s Duration seconds. duration_min Duration minutes. distance_m Distance metres. distance_km Distance kilometres. elevation_gain Elevation gain metres. avg_hr Average heart rate (bpm). calories Calories (kcal). training_load Training load score. avg_power Average power (watts). device Device name.

title: List activities — coros_activities
code: if (FALSE) { # interactive() auth <- coros_login()  # All activities in the last 30 days acts <- coros_activities(auth)  # Running and trail-running only library(dplyr) runs <- coros_activities(auth) |>   filter(sport_type %in% c(100L, 102L)) }

title: Fetch daily health and training metrics — coros_daily_metrics
text: tibble::tibble() sorted date columns: date Calendar date (Date). hrv Average overnight HRV (ms). hrv_baseline Personal HRV baseline (ms). rhr Resting heart rate (bpm). training_load Daily training load. load_ratio Training load ratio (acute:chronic). tired_rate Fatigue rate. ati Acute training impulse. cti Chronic training impulse. t7d 7-day training load. t28d 28-day training load. vo2max Estimated VO2max (mL/kg/min). lthr Lactate threshold heart rate (bpm). ltsp Lactate threshold speed. stamina Current stamina level. stamina_7d 7-day stamina level. performance Performance score. tib Time bed (minutes).

title: Authenticate with the COROS Training Hub API — coros_login
text: Logs email/password pair returns auth object must passed every coros_* function.  Credentials read environment variables default never hard-coded scripts.

code: coros_login(   email = Sys.getenv("COROS_EMAIL"),   password = Sys.getenv("COROS_PASSWORD"),   region = c("us", "eu") )

title: Authenticate with the COROS Training Hub API — coros_login
text: email COROS account e-mail.  Defaults COROS_EMAIL environment variable. password COROS account password.  Defaults COROS_PASSWORD. region API region: "us" (default) "eu".

title: Authenticate with the COROS Training Hub API — coros_login
text: named list fields access_token, user_id, base_url, region, timestamp.  Treat object opaque pass directly coros_* functions.

title: Fetch the training calendar — coros_schedule
text: auth coros_auth object coros_login(). start_day Start window "YYYYMMDD" format.  Defaults today. end_day End window "YYYYMMDD" format.  Defaults 14 days today.

title: Fetch the training calendar — coros_schedule
text: tibble::tibble() one row per scheduled item columns: plan_id Training plan identifier. id_in_plan Item position within plan. plan_program_id Associated workout program identifier. happen_day Scheduled date (Date). name Workout name. sport_type Numeric sport type code. sport_name Human-readable sport name. estimated_min Estimated duration minutes. completed Logical; TRUE workout completed.

title: Fetch the training calendar — coros_schedule
code: if (FALSE) { # interactive() auth <- coros_login()  # Upcoming two weeks schedule <- coros_schedule(auth)  # Narrower window schedule <- coros_schedule(   auth,   start_day = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),   end_day   = format(Sys.Date() + 7, "%Y%m%d") ) }

title: rCoros 0.1.0
text: Initial release. coros_login() authenticates COROS Training Hub API (US EU regions). coros_activities() lists activities automatic pagination via n_max = Inf. coros_activity_detail() returns per-activity summary, lap splits, HR zones. coros_daily_metrics() retrieves 28-day wellness metrics (HRV, RHR, VO2max, load). coros_hrv() returns recent overnight HRV readings. coros_workouts() lists structured workout programmes steps. coros_schedule() returns training calendar date window.
